## codec/gcf

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/codec/gcf` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/codec/gcf) · Stability: **stable**

Package gcf provides a provider.ToolResultCodec that encodes tool results as GCF (Graph Compact Format) instead of JSON when they are sent to the model.

**Functions**

- `func New() provider.ToolResultCodec`: New returns a GCF tool-result codec.

### type Codec

```go
type Codec struct{}
```

Codec renders a tool result's JSON bytes as a GCF document.

**Methods**

- `func (Codec) EncodeToolResult(raw json.RawMessage) (string, error)`: EncodeToolResult encodes the canonical JSON as GCF, keeping object keys in the tool's order and every number at exactly the value the tool returned.
